facts.business: HEG Limited manufactures graphite electrodes at the world's largest single-location plant in Mandideep, near Bhopal, India.

capacity_or_capex.item: Conversion of furnace oil-based burners to natural gas

guidance_or_targets.statement: Positioning for an upcycle expected over the coming five years with demand holding as supply recedes
Furnace oil to natural gas transition expected to replace approximately 3,000 MT of furnace oil annually
Furnace oil to natural gas transition expected to reduce ~2,500 MT of CO2e emissions per year

key_risks: Cyclical downturns in graphite electrode industry
Industry capacity utilization at 60-65% while HEG operates at 90%
Dependence on single-location plant at Mandideep
